# How close is your income to the 2026 ACA subsidy cliff?

> Free 2026 ACA subsidy cliff calculator: enter household size, MAGI and your benchmark premium to see your premium tax credit, how far you are from the 400% of poverty cliff, and how much a dollar over it costs. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
